title: Inside the lens
description: A graphite camera separates into a silver mount, an iris and a coated glass element along one continuous axis.
useCase: Explain a layered product through a clear, reversible exploded illustration.
interaction: Click the camera or the Explode view control to separate or assemble the optics.
reducedMotion: The optical assembly changes pose immediately for keyboard and reduced motion. Host pause disables both controls and settles the current pose.
limitations: A stylized projected SVG assembly, not a physically accurate lens prescription, CAD model or manufacturing diagram. The view angle is authored and fixed.
look: Soft grey-white radial backdrop with a graphite compact camera in angled projection, silver lens mount, teal coated glass, soft floor shadow and a pill button.
motion: Clicking slides the silver mount, iris and glass apart along the lens axis as the body shifts back, 600 ms with a strong ease-out; clicking again reassembles them.
adapt: Parts are SVG groups with class `ec-part` animated by `transition:transform 600ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`; `opticalDepth` sets each element's distance along the projected axis via `basis`, and `plane` and `face` handle the fixed 35° projection. Replace the camera artwork and depth values.
